name: Rufous-fronted Antthrush
rangeDescription: Southeastern peru (madre de dios), adjacent western brazil, and northwestern bolivia
description: Range-restricted antthrush of river’s-edge habitats and bamboo. Grayish brown, with an orange forehead.

name: Philippine Hawk-Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Philippines
description: A fairly large bird of lowland and montane forest. Dark gray-brown above with a rather long barred tail, a rufous chest, a gray hood, and a white throat.

name: Shelley's Eagle-Owl
rangeDescription: Sierra leone and liberia to cameroon, gabon, and northeastern democratic republic of the congo
description: Very large, dark rainforest owl. Note the dark brown upperparts, heavily barred underparts, and dark eyes.

name: Castelnau's Antshrike
rangeDescription: Northeastern ecuador to northern peru and western amazonian brazil
description: Large black antshrike with a white back patch. Males have white wingbars, absent in females.

name: Papuan Thornbill
rangeDescription: New guinea (snow mountains to owen stanley range)
description: A small bird of upper montane and subalpine forest canopy and bushes. Dull brown upperparts, whitish underparts and yellowish tinged head, neck and upper chest.

name: Pale-eyed Bulbul
rangeDescription: Southern myanmar (delta of the irrawaddy river)
description: Distinctive bulbul endemic to the Irrawaddy River delta in southern Myanmar. Note namesake white irises, as well as the yellow facial stripes.

name: Solomons White-eye
rangeDescription: Solomon islands (kolombangara, vonavona, kohinggo, new georgia, vangunu, and nggatokae)
description: Small olive-yellow warbler-like bird, restricted to a handful of islands in the New Georgia Group, in the west-central Solomon Islands. Formerly lumped with Dark-eyed White-eye; note present species’ bright white eye-ring and yellow belly.

name: Chestnut-breasted Whiteface
rangeDescription: Elevated gibber plains of central south australia
description: Small bird with stubby bill, found in open shrubland in stony country of arid northeastern South Australia. Warm brown above, white below, with broad rusty-brown chest band, reddish-brown marks on the flanks, pale eye, grayish throat, and white mark above bill.

name: Malayan Peacock-Pheasant
rangeDescription: Southern myanmar to southern thailand and malay peninsula
description: Odd-looking stumpy pheasant. Dull brown with iridescent green and blue eye-spots on the upperparts; these are much brighter and more prominent in the male.

name: Sri Lanka Gray Hornbill
rangeDescription: Moist deciduous forest of sri lanka
description: Small hornbill with gray upperside and whitish underparts. Bill has no casque, and is pale in males, dark in females.

name: Plain White-eye
rangeDescription: Forest and scrub of yap (northwestern caroline islands)
description: This small warbler-like bird is unremarkable in appearance, but surely not the plainest of the white-eyes; look for a pale eye with a very narrow white eyering, grayish upperparts, and contrasting pale yellow throat. Endemic to the island of Yap, in the Western Caroline Islands of Micronesia, where it inhabits a wide range of forested and brushy habitats.

name: Olive Honeyeater
rangeDescription: Moluccas and raja ampat islands (off western new guinea)
description: A nondescript sparrow-sized songbird with a slender, downcurved bill. Entirely olive-green above and uniform pale gray below, but note head pattern, which includes a prominent whitish smudge on the cheeks and dull bare skin below the eye.

name: South Polar Skua
rangeDescription: Breeds coastal antarctica, especially ross sea; also south shetland and south orkney islands (off antarctic peninsula); winters to northern offshore waters and north indian ocean: mostly clockwise to japanese and korean waters (western north pacific) and gulf stream of eastern usa (western north atlantic), then southwestern canada to northern baja california and northwestern africa
description: Bulky cold-brown seabird with white wing flashes. Usually seen singly in strong and direct flight, sometimes resting on the ocean with rafts of shearwaters.

name: Semiplumbeous Hawk
rangeDescription: Humid forest of honduras to western colombia and northwestern ecuador
description: Small forest hawk, usually seen perched inconspicuously in the canopy or at the forest edge. White below and gray above with distinctive orange-red legs and bill.

name: Rusty-breasted Wheatear
rangeDescription: Highlands of eritrea and ethiopia
description: A chunky brownish wheatear of mountain habitats. Note the white eyebrow, black mask, clean white throat, and cinnamon underparts.

name: Giant Shrike
rangeDescription: Mountains of eastern tibet; winters to southeastern china
description: A large and long-tailed shrike with dark gray upperparts, white underparts, a black mask, and white in the wing. The white patches in the black wings and tail are especially conspicuous in flight.

name: Pygmy Batis
rangeDescription: Arid southern ethiopia, sudan, somalia, and kenya to far northeastern tanzania
description: A small batis with typical black, white, and gray markings. Note the chest band, which is black in males and rufous in females.

name: Australasian Gannet
rangeDescription: Breeds islands off southeastern australia including tasmania, and coasts and islands off new zealand
description: Large black-and-white seabird with heavy, pointed bill. Adult white with black flight feathers and central tail feathers, yellow-washed head.

name: Cinnamon-rumped Foliage-gleaner
rangeDescription: Southeastern colombia to southern venezuela, the guianas, northern bolivia, and eastern amazonian brazil
description: Medium-sized, richly-colored bird of swampy forests. Mostly rufous brown with a dark brown crown and back and a bright rufous-orange tail.

name: Spot-winged Grosbeak
rangeDescription: Mountains of northern pakistan to southern tibet, southwestern china, myanmar, and thailand
description: A large, heavy-billed finch. Male is black above and yellow below with white streaks and spots on the wings.
